# Spec: the Graphic dialog (phase 1 of 2 — browse, preview, insert; `.fjgraphic` export is phase 2)

## Goal
Insert ▸ Graphic… opens a sheet with categories | graphics | a looping preview, From File… at the bottom left and Cancel / Insert at the right, replacing the Insert ▸ Graphic submenu; every bundled template declares `meta.category` and `meta.description`. Agents get `list_graphics` and `insert_graphic`, the dialog's two acts.

## Files
- `graphic/tests/graphics/*.js` (all 23) — add `category` and a one-line `description` to `meta`; no other byte changes.
- `graphic/tests/template_meta.rs` (new) — every template's `meta.category` equals G-45 (c)'s table, `description` is a non-empty one-line string ≤ 120 chars.
- `graphic/CLAUDE.md` — the templates rule names G-45 and `template_meta.rs`.
- `docs/graphics-api.md`, `docs/graphics-api.d.ts` — `Meta` gains `category?` and `description?` (what the dialog does with each).
- `app/Sources/GraphicCatalog.swift` (new) — `GraphicBrowserItem`, `GraphicBrowserCategory`, `GraphicCatalog`, `GraphicTemplateLibrary`.
- `app/Sources/GraphicBrowserSheetController.swift` (new) — the sheet.
- `app/Sources/GraphicPreviewPlayer.swift` (new) — the off-main preview loop.
- `app/Sources/ProjectDocument+GraphicInsert.swift` (new) — the insert bodies both doors share.
- `app/Sources/EditorViewController+GraphicMenus.swift` — `showGraphicBrowser(_:)` replaces `insertGraphicTemplate(_:)`; `insertGraphicFromFile` stops being a menu action (the sheet's From File… calls it); `insertGraphic(from:grouped:)` delegates to the document bodies; add `insertProjectGraphic(named:grouped:)`; validator arms.
- `app/Sources/EditorViewController+AddClips.swift` — extract `addGeneratedClip`'s track choice into `static generatedClipOps` (behaviour unchanged).
- `app/Sources/AppDelegate+GraphicMenu.swift` — Insert holds Adjustment Clip, then one item "Graphic…"; `graphicMenu()` removed; header comment rewritten.
- `app/Sources/GraphicTemplates.swift` — header comment (titles now come from `meta.name`; `title(for:)` is the fallback); `list(in:)` unchanged.
- `app/Sources/GraphicRegistry.swift` — `compile(_:library:)` from `private` to internal (reused by `GraphicTemplateLibrary`).
- `app/Sources/AgentServer+GraphicRender.swift` — `graphicContext(...)` from `private` to internal (reused by the preview).
- `app/Sources/AgentServer+GraphicBrowser.swift` (new) — `listGraphics`, `insertGraphic` handlers.
- `app/Sources/AgentCatalog+Graphics.swift` — two `tool(...)` rows after `restore_graphic`; header comment; `add_graphic_clip`'s "Insert ▸ Graphic is…" sentence updated.
- `app/Sources/AgentServer.swift` (frozen) — two handler-table rows only.
- `app/Sources/AssistantPrompt.swift` — the graphics `searchTopics` row gains both tools (F4 needs every tool exactly once).
- `app/Sources/UIMenuTable.swift` — drop `insertGraphicTemplate:` / `insertGraphicFromFile:`, add `"showGraphicBrowser:": .sheet`.
- `app/Sources/AgentCatalog.swift`, `app/Sources/AgentServer+Gate.swift` — "ninety-eight" → "one hundred" in comments.
- `tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.json` — the selectors and sites to match (the browser's `presentAsSheet`; From File…'s `beginSheetModal` now `reached_after` `showGraphicBrowser:`).
- `tools/proof/graphics_menu_probe.swift`, `tools/proof/graphics_menu_proof.py` — M2 (Insert ▸ Graphic… one item), M4/M5 (selectors), M6/M7 through the sheet; new rows below; mutants.
- `tools/proof/graphic_browser_proof.py` (new) — the MCP proof below, with one `APP_MUTANTS` entry through `tree_copy` (as `graphics_menu_proof.py`).
- `tools/proof/sheet_queue_probe.swift` — V1's door list: `insertGraphicFromFile:` and `insertGraphicTemplate:` replaced by `showGraphicBrowser:`.
- `tools/proof/op_argument_proof.py` (`PRODUCT_TOOLS = 100`), `phase9_proof.py`, `recording_proof.py`, `recording_probe.py` (`APP_STATE_TOOLS` += both) — tool counts/sets.
- `tools/proof/README.md` — the new proof's section; the count paragraph (100); `graphics_menu_proof.py`'s rows and `PROBE_MUTANTS`; `sheet_queue_probe`'s V1 list and its site table rows (`insertGraphicFromFile:`, `reportingGraphicFailure` via `insertGraphicTemplate:`) re-pathed to the sheet.
- `designs/screens/15e-graphic-browser-sheet.md` (new) — `perform_menu_item ["Insert","Graphic…"]`, capture `sheet`, `cancel_sheet`.
- `designs/spec/11-decisions/graphics.md` (G-45), `designs/spec/11-decisions/README.md` (row, lines cell), `designs/spec/09-keys-and-menus.md` (Insert), `designs/spec/07.9c-agent-graphics-dev-tools-transport.md` (G5b paragraph, the two tools), `designs/spec/07.9a-agent-tools.md` (count), `designs/spec/README.md` (lines cells).
- `docs/guide/graphics.md` ("Adding a graphic": the dialog, categories, This Project; the table gains a Category column), `docs/guide/menus-and-shortcuts.md` (Insert row), `docs/guide/mcp.md` (count, two rows), `docs/manual-checks.md` (new GR-14; the "Insert ▸ Graphic ▸ X" steps of CT-8 (line 234), GR-4 (550), GR-12 (599) and GR-13 (606) re-pathed to Insert ▸ Graphic…), `CONTEXT.md` (Template: Insert ▸ Graphic…, title from `meta.name`; add **Category**), `README.md` (the "Motion graphics" highlight: the 23 built-ins browsed by category with a live preview).
- `CLAUDE.md`, `app/CLAUDE.md` — map entries for the new files and the changed roles; "ninety-eight" → "one hundred"; the app-state tool list.

## Interfaces
```swift
// GraphicCatalog.swift
struct GraphicBrowserItem: Equatable {
    enum Origin: String { case template, project }
    let name: String            // template: file stem; project: module name
    let title: String           // GraphicCatalog.title(meta:name:); a This Project duplicate gets " — <name>" (G-45 (e))
    let description: String?
    let category: String        // the module's own (meta.category, else "Other")
    let origin: Origin
    let ok: Bool                // compiled
}
struct GraphicBrowserCategory: Equatable { let name: String; let items: [GraphicBrowserItem] }
enum GraphicCatalog {
    static let thisProject = "This Project", other = "Other"
    static func category(meta: [String: Any]) -> String
    static func title(meta: [String: Any], name: String) -> String       // meta.name if non-empty string, else GraphicTemplates.title(for:)
    static func description(meta: [String: Any]) -> String?
    static func categories(templates: [GraphicBrowserItem], project: [GraphicBrowserItem]) -> [GraphicBrowserCategory]  // G-45 (d), (e)'s disambiguation
    static func categories(for document: ProjectDocument) -> [GraphicBrowserCategory]  // main only
}
final class GraphicTemplateLibrary {
    struct Entry { let template: GraphicTemplate; let entry: GraphicRegistry.Entry }
    static let shared: GraphicTemplateLibrary   // GraphicTemplates.bundledDirectory, ProjectDocument.bundledFontsDirectory
    init(directory: URL, fonts: URL)
    var entries: [Entry] { get }                 // compiled once (NSLock-memoised), first read on main
    func entry(named: String) -> Entry?
}
// GraphicPreviewPlayer.swift
final class GraphicPreviewPlayer {
    enum Subject { case module(GraphicModule, name: String, meta: [String: Any]); case failed(name: String, [GraphicDiagnostic]) }
    init(canvas: CanvasSnapshot, onFrame: @escaping (CGImage) -> Void)   // onFrame delivered on main, newest subject only
    func play(_ subject: Subject?)   // main
    func stop()                      // main; the render thread exits
}
// GraphicBrowserSheetController.swift
final class GraphicBrowserSheetController: NSViewController {
    init(document: ProjectDocument, editor: EditorViewController)
}
// identifiers: graphicbrowser.categories, .graphics, .preview, .title, .description, .message, .fromFile, .cancel, .insert
// ProjectDocument+GraphicInsert.swift
extension ProjectDocument {
    func writeGraphicModule(from url: URL) throws -> String                       // UTF-8 check, uniqueModuleName, write, rescan; the name
    func graphicClipMaker(named name: String) throws -> (UInt32, Ticks) -> ReelOp // meta duration/size + schema; throws "graphics/<name>.js does not compile: <msg>[ (line N)]"
}
// EditorViewController
@objc func showGraphicBrowser(_ sender: Any?)
func insertProjectGraphic(named: String, grouped: Bool) throws
static func generatedClipOps(in document: ProjectDocument, _ make: (UInt32, Ticks) -> ReelOp) -> [ReelOp]
// AgentServer
func listGraphics(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String   // UI path: Insert ▸ Graphic…'s two lists
func insertGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String  // UI path: Insert ▸ Graphic…'s Insert
```
MCP: `list_graphics {}` → `{"categories":[{"name","graphics":[{"name","title","description"|null,"category","from":"template"|"project","ok"}]}]}`, the dialog's order exactly. `insert_graphic {name: string (required), from: "template"|"project" (required)}` → `editResult(document, "Insert Graphic", ops, ["name": <module placed>])`; unknown name refused naming it and listing that origin's names; a document with no editor/store refused with `insertGraphic`'s existing sentence. Neither in `offMainTools`; no `scope` (app-state).

## Approach
1. **Spec §11 G-45 first** (graphics.md, README row "amends G-16"): (a) a module's category is `meta.category` when a string non-empty after trimming, else "Other"; (b) every bundled template declares one of Data & Time, Screencast, Social & YouTube, Titles & Text, and a one-line `meta.description`; (c) Data & Time: bar-chart, counter, countdown, donut-chart, gauge, line-chart, progress-bar; Screencast: arrow-highlight, callout, keyboard-keys, step-badge, window-frame; Titles & Text: chapter-card, kinetic-type, logo-reveal, lower-third, news-ticker, quote-card, title-card; Social & YouTube: end-screen, handle-tag, social-popup, subscribe-button; (d) the list: This Project first, only when the package's `graphics/` holds a module (every project module, whatever its own category), then the templates' categories by case-insensitive name, Other last; items by title case-insensitively, then name; (e) title is `meta.name`, else the stem title; a This Project item whose title equals another This Project item's (case-insensitive) is shown as "<title> — <module name>" (sheet and `list_graphics` alike); templates are now compiled (once per process, against the bundled fonts) — the menu bar still compiles nothing; (f) the door is Insert ▸ Graphic…, a sheet; Insert is G-16's act for a template, and for a This Project graphic places a clip drawn by that module with no copy; one undo step "Insert Graphic".
2. Templates' `meta` (23 files) + `template_meta.rs`; docs `Meta` keys. `cargo test --release` in `graphic/`.
3. `ProjectDocument+GraphicInsert.swift` and `generatedClipOps`, moving code out of `insertGraphic(from:grouped:)` / `addGeneratedClip` with no behaviour change; `make typecheck`.
4. `GraphicCatalog.swift`; `GraphicPreviewPlayer` — one Foundation `Thread` per player, `stackSize = GraphicPrefetch.workerStackBytes`; frame = ⌊elapsed × fps⌋ mod length (meta `durationInFrames`, else 5 s ceiled); ctx from `AgentServer.graphicContext` at the module's size (meta width/height, else the canvas), `props` `"{}"`, `GraphicRegistry.previewBudgetMs`; raster composited over `render_graphic`'s checker into a `CGImage`; a throw or a `.failed` subject is the error card (`LayerRenderers.errorCardText` + `paintErrorCard`); paced to fps, skipping when slow; never touches AppKit or the document off main.
5. The sheet: fixed content ~920×560; three single-column `NSTableView`s (categories ~180 pt, graphics ~240 pt) and the preview well at the canvas aspect ratio with title (bold) and description (one line, tail-truncated) under it; message label above the bottom bar; bottom bar From File… left, Cancel (Esc) and Insert (Return, default) right. Opens on the first category's first graphic. Insert disabled with no graphic selected; double-click a graphic = Insert. Insert runs in the button's event (`grouped: false`), dismisses on success, and on a throw shows the sentence word for word in the message label and stays up. From File… sets a pending flag and dismisses; the controller's `viewDidDisappear` then calls `editor.insertGraphicFromFile(nil)` (ReverseProgressSheetController.swift:75-84's pattern: a sheet just dismissed is still `attachedSheet`). `viewDidDisappear` also calls `player.stop()`, so every close (Cancel, Esc, Insert, From File…) stops the render thread. `showGraphicBrowser` presents with `presentAsSheet`; validator: `document?.graphicStore != nil`.
6. Menu, `UIMenuTable`, `inventory.json`; agent handlers, catalog rows, `AssistantPrompt` row, frozen-file wiring.
7. Docs, spec, screen file, manual-check GR-14 ("the Graphic dialog looks right and plays": light and dark, each category, the loop smooth at the canvas aspect, descriptions readable, Esc / Return / double-click).
8. Proofs: `graphics_menu_probe.swift` new rows — the sheet opens on the first category; Insert disabled after deselecting; Titles & Text ▸ Lower third via the insert button writes `lower-third.js` byte-equal to the bundled one and one undoable "Insert Graphic" clip; This Project then appears first and inserting from it writes no file; Esc writes nothing; a failing project module's Insert leaves the sentence in `graphicbrowser.message` and the sheet up; the preview image view gets a non-nil image within 3 s, rendered off main; after a successful Insert the player's render thread has exited (`Thread.isFinished`, bounded 2 s); pressing From File… leaves the browser gone and an `NSOpenPanel` as the window's `attachedSheet` within 2 s (then cancelled); inserting Lower third a second time from Titles & Text makes This Project list "Lower third — lower-third" and "Lower third — lower-third-2"; catalog rows over fixture items through `GraphicCatalog.categories(templates:project:)` — no category → "Other", empty project → no This Project, This Project first, G-45 (d) order — and the sheet's two tables' rows equal `GraphicCatalog.categories(for:)`. `graphic_browser_proof.py` (own instance, scratch home, `graphics_menu_proof.py`'s launch): `list_graphics` order and the 23 by G-45 (c), This Project absent then present; `insert_graphic` template / project / failing / unknown / bad `from`; `perform_menu_item ["Insert","Graphic…"]` + `snapshot_ui` sheet in light and dark (`-RCDevAppearance`), layout dump holding the nine identifiers, `cancel_sheet`. Mutants (8): seven `graphics_menu_proof.py` `PROBE_MUTANTS` under Rule R1 — `browser-fallback` (fallback not "Other"), `browser-project-empty` (This Project shown when empty), `browser-project-last` (This Project not first), `browser-insert-enabled` (Insert enabled with nothing selected), `browser-project-copies` (project insert writes a copy), `browser-skip-unique` (template insert skips `uniqueModuleName`), `browser-player-kept` (`viewDidDisappear`'s `stop()` removed); one `graphic_browser_proof.py` `APP_MUTANTS` under Rule R — `list-templates-only` (the `list_graphics` handler drops This Project), caught by the "This Project present" row.

## Constraints
- `EditorViewController.swift` and `AgentServer.swift` are frozen: wiring rows only. New files ≤ 400 lines; no file listed here may cross 600 (`wc -l`).
- Never call `rescan()` from a `.graphicsDidChange` / `.projectGraphicsDidChange` observer; `writeGraphicModule` calls it from the command, as `insertGraphic` does today.
- In-event edits use `applyEdit` (`grouped: false`), off-event `performGroupedEdit` (app/CLAUDE.md undo pitfall); the agent uses `editResult`, whose `addressed` stamps the view's scope, so a nest open places inside it as the sheet does.
- No engine call on main except the one-time template compile and the registry's existing compiles; QuickJS needs the 8 MiB thread (`GraphicPrefetch` pattern), never a GCD thread.
- The menu bar compiles nothing (chrome probes instantiate `AppDelegate()`).
- `ReelCore.swift` is not touched in phase 1 (no FFI). Typecheck baseline stays 0 errors / 4 warnings.
- Agent parity (spec §7.9): both tools' catalog rows and handlers, a comment naming the UI path; the gate checks keys against the published schema.
- No persisting menu item or `UserDefaults` write; the proofs launch in a scratch home.
- Spec §11 decisions are not re-litigated: G-16 is amended by G-45, written before code.

## Verification
Targeted (run while iterating; covers only the code in **Files**):
```
cd graphic && cargo test --release --test template_meta --test templates
make typecheck
python3 tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.py --check
python3 tools/proof/spec_index_proof.py
python3 tools/proof/assistant_prompt_proof.py --probe
python3 tools/proof/sheet_queue_probe.py --only V1
make app-debug && python3 tools/proof/graphics_menu_proof.py
python3 tools/proof/graphic_browser_proof.py
```

```

RC_PROOF_APP=release python3 tools/proof/graphics_menu_proof.py     # covers: Insert ▸ Graphic… and the sheet's acts
RC_PROOF_APP=release python3 tools/proof/graphic_browser_proof.py   # covers: list_graphics, insert_graphic, the sheet light and dark
python3 tools/proof/op_argument_proof.py <dir>/agent.sock          # covers: 100 product tools, the gate on the two new ones (Release instance from proof_app.py launch --app release)
python3 tools/proof/phase9_proof.py <dir>/agent.sock               # covers: the exact app-state tool set
python3 tools/proof/graphics_menu_proof.py --mutant <name>          # each of the seven browser-* probe mutants, once, at the end
python3 tools/proof/graphic_browser_proof.py --mutant list-templates-only   # the app-tier mutant, once, at the end (builds a tree copy)
python3 tools/proof/sheet_queue_probe.py --only V1                  # covers: showGraphicBrowser: validates false under an attached alert
```
Passing means: `make gate` exits 0 with exactly the 4 baseline warnings; each proof's last line is `<n>/<n> checks passed`; `grep "Frame Job: " <dir>/framejob.log` prints nothing; every mutant is caught under its proof's rule (R1: its own row is the first failure; R: exit 0).

## Out of scope
- **Phase 2, `.fjgraphic` export** (its own spec): Export… at the sheet's far left and `export_graphic {name, from, path}` (an `AssistantToolTable` `askFirst` row; likely `offMainTools`, which `agent_open_proof.py` pins textually); a stored (method 0) zip, CRC-32 in Swift, holding `manifest.json` (format version, module, title, category, description, app version, files with SHA-256), the `.js`, and only the used `fonts/` / `assets/`; usage from the engine: `graphic::Library` records font faces chosen (`select_font` and the fallback selector, mapped face → font blob index) and asset hrefs resolved into the existing `Probe`, merged per call, read through a new `rc_graphic_library_usage` (core `ffi_graphic.rs`, header, `ReelCore.swift` — which first pays the toll named in `designs/adr/app-file-history.md`: the `Data`-to-pointer helpers), over a sample of frames at default props plus the schema's `asset` defaults; bundled fonts never copied; a `com.kgalligan.framejob-graphic` exported UTI conforming to `public.zip-archive` in `project.yml`; a §11 decision for the format and the usage rule.
- Import of `.fjgraphic` (filed as an issue when phase 2 closes).
- Thumbnails in the graphics list, search, user-defined categories beyond `meta.category`, remembering the last category.

## Objections addressed

1	# Spec: the Graphic dialog (phase 1 of 2 — browse, preview, insert; `.fjgraphic` export is phase 2)
2	
3	## Goal
4	Insert ▸ Graphic… opens a sheet with categories | graphics | a looping preview, From File… at the bottom left and Cancel / Insert at the right, replacing the Insert ▸ Graphic submenu; every bundled template declares `meta.category` and `meta.description`. Agents get `list_graphics` and `insert_graphic`, the dialog's two acts.
5	
6	## Files
7	- `graphic/tests/graphics/*.js` (all 23) — add `category` and a one-line `description` to `meta`; no other byte changes.
8	- `graphic/tests/template_meta.rs` (new) — every template's `meta.category` equals G-45 (c)'s table, `description` is a non-empty one-line string ≤ 120 chars.
9	- `graphic/CLAUDE.md` — the templates rule names G-45 and `template_meta.rs`.
10	- `docs/graphics-api.md`, `docs/graphics-api.d.ts` — `Meta` gains `category?` and `description?` (what the dialog does with each).

1	// app/Sources/GraphicBrowserSheetController.swift — Insert ▸ Graphic… (spec
     2	// §11 G-45): a sheet of three panes — the categories, the graphics of the
     3	// chosen one, and a looping preview of the chosen graphic with its title and
     4	// one-line description — over a message line and a bottom bar of From File…
     5	// at the left and Cancel and Insert at the right.
     6	//
     7	// **What it lists is `GraphicCatalog.categories(for:)`**, read once when the
     8	// sheet is made, in the order `list_graphics` answers. It opens on the first
     9	// category's first graphic; Insert is disabled with no graphic chosen, and a
    10	// double-click on a graphic is Insert.
    11	//
    12	// **No second implementation.** Insert is one call of the editor's body —
    13	// `insertGraphic(from:grouped:)` with the template's URL, or
    14	// `insertProjectGraphic(named:grouped:)` for This Project — the bodies the
    15	// old menu items called, which call `ProjectDocument+GraphicInsert.swift`
    16	// as `insert_graphic` does. It runs inside the button's event, so `grouped:
    17	// false` (`applyEdit`). A success dismisses the sheet; a throw beeps and
    18	// shows the sentence word for word in `messageLabel`, and the sheet stays.
    19	//
    20	// **What follows the sheet starts in `viewDidDisappear`**, for
    21	// `ReverseProgressSheetController`'s reason: a sheet dismissed a moment ago
    22	// is still the window's `attachedSheet`. From File… only sets a flag and
    23	// dismisses; the open panel is begun there, once the browser is down. And
    24	// the preview's render thread is stopped there, so every way out — Cancel,
    25	// Esc, Insert, From File… — stops it.

1	// app/Sources/GraphicPreviewPlayer.swift — the Insert ▸ Graphic… sheet's
     2	// looping preview (spec §11 G-45): one graphic module drawn frame after
     3	// frame on a thread of its own, each frame handed to main as a `CGImage`.
     4	//
     5	// **One Foundation `Thread` per player, 8 MiB of stack**
     6	// (`GraphicPrefetch.workerStackBytes`): QuickJS needs the deep stack, which
     7	// a GCD thread does not have. The thread waits on an `NSCondition` while
     8	// there is nothing to play, draws the subject's frame ⌊elapsed × fps⌋ mod
     9	// its length, and waits until the next frame is due — a frame that took
    10	// longer than one frame is followed by the frame due NOW, so a slow graphic
    11	// skips rather than drifts. `stop()` ends the thread; nothing restarts it.
    12	//
    13	// **The thread touches no AppKit and no document.** Everything it reads is
    14	// handed to it in `play`: the module (which holds its library, so the
    15	// document's rescans cannot pull it away), its name and `meta`, and the
    16	// canvas captured at init. A frame is delivered by a main hop, and only
    17	// while its subject is still the newest one and the player has not stopped.
    18	//
    19	// **The picture is `render_graphic`'s**: the ctx is `AgentServer.graphicContext`
    20	// at the module's size (`meta` width and height, else the canvas), with
    21	// `props` `{}` — the schema's defaults — at `GraphicRegistry.previewBudgetMs`,
    22	// composited over the contact sheet's checker
    23	// (`GraphicContactSheet.paintChecker`). A frame that throws, and a module
    24	// that does not compile, is the error card (`LayerRenderers.errorCardText`,
    25	// `paintErrorCard`).
    26	
    27	import AppKit
    28	
    29	final class GraphicPreviewPlayer {
    30	    enum Subject {
    31	        case module(GraphicModule, name: String, meta: [String: Any])
    32	        case failed(name: String, [GraphicDiagnostic])
    33	    }
    34	
    35	    /// What the thread and main share, under `condition`.
    36	    private final class State {
    37	        let condition = NSCondition()
    38	        var subject: Subject?
    39	        var generation = 0
    40	        var stopped = false
    41	        var framesDrawn = 0
    42	        var drewOnMain = false
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    private let state = State()
    46	    private let canvas: CanvasSnapshot
    47	    private let onFrame: (CGImage) -> Void
    48	    /// The render thread, once the first `play` has started it.
    49	    private(set) var thread: Thread?
    50	
    51	    init(canvas: CanvasSnapshot, onFrame: @escaping (CGImage) -> Void) {
    52	        self.canvas = canvas
    53	        self.onFrame = onFrame
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    deinit { stop() }
    57	
    58	    /// Plays `subject` from its frame 0, or nothing for nil. Main.
    59	    func play(_ subject: Subject?) {
    60	        state.condition.lock()
    61	        let stopped = state.stopped
    62	        state.subject = subject
    63	        state.generation += 1
    64	        state.condition.broadcast()
    65	        state.condition.unlock()
    66	        guard !stopped, thread == nil else { return }
    67	        let state = self.state
    68	        let canvas = self.canvas
    69	        let made = Thread { [weak self] in
    70	            Self.run(state, canvas) { image, generation in
    71	                DispatchQueue.main.async { self?.deliver(image, generation) }
    72	            }
    73	        }
    74	        made.stackSize = GraphicPrefetch.workerStackBytes
    75	        made.qualityOfService = .userInitiated
    76	        made.name = "framejob.graphic-preview"
    77	        thread = made
    78	        made.start()
    79	    }
    80	
    81	    /// Ends the render thread; a later `play` does nothing. Main.
    82	    func stop() {
    83	        state.condition.lock()
    84	        state.stopped = true
    85	        state.subject = nil
    86	        state.condition.broadcast()
    87	        state.condition.unlock()
    88	    }
    89	
    90	    /// Frames drawn so far, and whether any was drawn on the main thread
    91	    /// (the probe's read of "off main"). Any thread.
    92	    var drawn: (frames: Int, onMain: Bool) {
    93	        state.condition.lock()
    94	        defer { state.condition.unlock() }
    95	        return (state.framesDrawn, state.drewOnMain)
    96	    }
    97	
    98	    /// Main: hands `image` on when it is still the newest subject's.
    99	    private func deliver(_ image: CGImage, _ generation: Int) {
   100	        state.condition.lock()
   101	        let current = !state.stopped && state.generation == generation
   102	        state.condition.unlock()
   103	        if current { onFrame(image) }
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    // MARK: - The thread
   107	
   108	    private static func run(
   109	        _ state: State, _ canvas: CanvasSnapshot, _ deliver: (CGImage, Int) -> Void
   110	    ) {
   111	        var playing = -1
   112	        var subject: Subject?
   113	        var start = Date()
   114	        var cardShown = false
   115	        while true {
   116	            state.condition.lock()
   117	            while !state.stopped && state.subject == nil { state.condition.wait() }
   118	            if state.stopped {
   119	                state.condition.unlock()
   120	                return
   121	            }
   122	            if state.generation != playing {
   123	                playing = state.generation
   124	                subject = state.subject
   125	                start = Date()
   126	                cardShown = false
   127	            }
   128	            state.condition.unlock()
   129	            guard let current = subject else { continue }
   130	
   131	            let fps = max(canvas.fps.double, 1)
   132	            var next = Date().addingTimeInterval(1 / fps)
   133	            switch current {
   134	            case .failed(let name, let diagnostics):
   135	                if !cardShown {
   136	                    let text = LayerRenderers.errorCardText(
   137	                        name: name, frame: nil, diagnostic: diagnostics.first)

    16	// canvas captured at init. A frame is delivered by a main hop, and only
    17	// while its subject is still the newest one and the player has not stopped.

1	//! The bundled templates' `meta.category` and `meta.description` (spec §11
     2	//! G-45 (b), (c)): every module of `tests/graphics/` — road map 10's six
     3	//! fixtures included, since all 23 are templates — declares exactly the
     4	//! category G-45 (c)'s table gives its stem, and a one-line description of
     5	//! 1–120 characters. The Insert ▸ Graphic… dialog files a template under
     6	//! its category and shows the description under the preview; the table is
     7	//! written out here, so a template added without a row fails.
     8	
     9	mod common;
    10	
    11	use std::fs;
    12	
    13	use common::{module, GRAPHICS};
    14	
    15	/// G-45 (c), category by category.
    16	const TABLE: [(&str, &[&str]); 4] = [
    17	    (
    18	        "Data & Time",
    19	        &[
    20	            "bar-chart",
    21	            "counter",
    22	            "countdown",
    23	            "donut-chart",
    24	            "gauge",
    25	            "line-chart",
    26	            "progress-bar",
    27	        ],
    28	    ),
    29	    (
    30	        "Screencast",
    31	        &[
    32	            "arrow-highlight",
    33	            "callout",
    34	            "keyboard-keys",
    35	            "step-badge",
    36	            "window-frame",
    37	        ],
    38	    ),
    39	    (
    40	        "Titles & Text",
    41	        &[
    42	            "chapter-card",
    43	            "kinetic-type",
    44	            "logo-reveal",
    45	            "lower-third",
    46	            "news-ticker",
    47	            "quote-card",
    48	            "title-card",
    49	        ],
    50	    ),
    51	    (
    52	        "Social & YouTube",
    53	        &[
    54	            "end-screen",
    55	            "handle-tag",
    56	            "social-popup",
    57	            "subscribe-button",
    58	        ],
    59	    ),
    60	];
    61	
    62	/// Every `*.js` stem in the folder, sorted.
    63	fn stems() -> Vec<String> {
    64	    let mut stems: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(GRAPHICS)
    65	        .expect("tests/graphics")
    66	        .map(|entry| entry.expect("a directory entry").path())
    67	        .filter(|path| path.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "js"))
    68	        .map(|path| path.file_stem().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
    69	        .collect();
    70	    stems.sort();
    71	    stems
    72	}
    73	
    74	fn category_of(stem: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    75	    TABLE
    76	        .iter()
    77	        .find(|(_, stems)| stems.contains(&stem))
    78	        .map(|(category, _)| *category)
    79	}
    80	
    81	#[test]
    82	fn the_table_names_every_template_once() {
    83	    let mut listed: Vec<String> = TABLE
    84	        .iter()
    85	        .flat_map(|(_, stems)| stems.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()))
    86	        .collect();
    87	    listed.sort();
    88	    assert_eq!(listed.len(), 23, "G-45 (c) names 23 templates");
    89	    assert_eq!(
    90	        listed,
    91	        stems(),
    92	        "the folder's templates and G-45 (c)'s table"
    93	    );
    94	}
    95	
    96	#[test]
    97	fn every_template_declares_its_category_and_a_one_line_description() {
    98	    let mut problems = Vec::new();
    99	    for stem in stems() {
   100	        let compiled = module(&stem);
   101	        let meta = compiled.meta();
   102	        let want = category_of(&stem);
   103	        let category = meta["category"].as_str();
   104	        if category != want {
   105	            problems.push(format!(
   106	                "{stem}: meta.category {category:?}, wanted {want:?}"
   107	            ));
   108	        }
   109	        match meta["description"].as_str() {
   110	            None => problems.push(format!("{stem}: meta.description is not a string")),
   111	            Some(text) => {
   112	                let length = text.chars().count();
   113	                if text.trim().is_empty() || length > 120 || text.contains(['\n', '\r']) {
   114	                    problems.push(format!(
   115	                        "{stem}: meta.description {text:?} is not one line of 1–120 \
   116	                         characters ({length})"
   117	                    ));
   118	                }
   119	            }
   120	        }
   121	    }
   122	    assert!(problems.is_empty(), "{problems:#?}");
   123	}

1	// app/Sources/GraphicRegistry.swift — the compiled graphics each document
2	// draws with (road map 10 §5f's registry paragraph, G3b): a `RecipeSource`
3	// key → one immutable `GraphicSet`, the library and every module of that
4	// document's `graphics/` compiled against it.
5	//
6	// **Preview follows the newest revision** (G-13): the document installs its
7	// set when its store starts and swaps a NEW set in on every
8	// `.graphicsDidChange` (`ProjectDocument+Graphics.swift`). A font or asset
9	// change builds a new library and recompiles every module against it — a
10	// library is frozen by its first compile — and anything else recompiles only
11	// the named modules against the existing library. Nothing here calls
12	// `store.rescan()`: `drain()` is not re-entrant (road map 10 §10.6 G3a).
13	//
14	// **Threading.** `install`, `update`, `remove` and `entry` are main-only,
15	// because the store's scan is. `resolve`, `snapshot` and the pin's five
16	// calls are any-thread — the compositor's render queue and a `render_frame`
17	// generator thread — and the lock covers only the two maps; a module draws
18	// on a thread that did not compile it (the engine keeps per-thread
19	// runtimes, G1c).
20	//
21	// **An offline key** — the one `Exporter.renderFrame` or an export mints —
22	// draws with the set its caller PINNED on it (G-13, G3c): the document's
23	// set as it stood when the export or the frame was asked for, retained for
24	// the key's life however the document's own set changes. A key with no
25	// set and no pin resolves nil and the layer draws the slate. A pin also
26	// holds what the key's graphics REPORTED — the first failure in a slot of
27	// its own, then up to 64 warnings distinct by graphic and messages, the
28	// frame aside, so one graphic warning every frame keeps one (G-24 (c)) — for
29	// `render_frame`'s reply, the export's abort and its `graphicWarnings`.

IDENTIFIERS = ["graphicbrowser." + n for n in (
    "categories", "graphics", "preview", "title", "description", "message", "fromFile", "cancel",
    "insert")]
BROKEN = "export function render() { return"

# name -> (file under app/Sources, anchor, replacement, the row that must fail)
APP_MUTANTS = {
    "list-templates-only": (
        "AgentServer+GraphicBrowser.swift",
        "        let categories = GraphicCatalog.categories(for: document).map { category in\n",
        "        let categories = GraphicCatalog.categories(for: document)\n"
        "            .filter { $0.name != GraphicCatalog.thisProject }.map { category in\n",
        "L2"),
}

RESULTS = []




def mutate(sources, name):
    file, anchor, replacement, _ = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    text = (sources / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(anchor)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"anchor in {file}: expected once, found {count}")
    (sources / file).write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")


def app_mutant(name):
    """Rule R: 0 the row FAILED in the copy, 1 it passed, 2 the control was
    not performed."""
    row = APP_MUTANTS[name][3]
    print(f"graphic browser — the {name} MUTANT ({row} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(WORK / "mutant"))
    if made is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    copy = Path(made)
    try:
        mutate(copy / "app/Sources", name)
    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(copy, 1500)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    session(proof_app.executable(app), "light", tool_rows)
    scored = {n.split()[0]: ok for n, ok in RESULTS}
    if row not in scored:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {row} was not reached")
        return 2
    failed = [n.split()[0] for n, ok in RESULTS if not ok]
    caught = scored[row] is False
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — {row} "
          f"{'FAILED' if caught else 'passed'} in the copy (failed: {', '.join(failed)})")
    return 0 if caught else 1
